answer: A farm faking 345 aliases needs 345 separate harvest histories, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Basket weaver guild record with willow harvest history is the check: willow harvested from one bed season after season. The zephyr check is what stops the copy-paste farm: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The bridge record is public, the tide cost is per identity, and 345 aliases cost 345 times one honest seat.
